claim_ceiling: Illustrative organizational AI deployment fabric; model outputs are not independent external evidence.

relations.mechanism_status: deployment can create repeated workflow dependence
relations.counterfactual_status: no deployment means no tool-specific routine

relations.mechanism_status: possible but not assumed; output must be checked against external sources and artifacts

propagation_channels.carrier_or_medium: tokens, files, reviews, CI, organizational process
propagation_channels.speed_bound: network and human workflow latency; no physical superluminal claim
propagation_channels.attenuation: review, tests, and external evidence reduce error propagation
propagation_channels.amplification: automation, authority bias, and reuse can amplify output
propagation_channels.transformation: prompt/data becomes suggestion, code, report, or decision artifact
propagation_channels.capacity_or_resource_limit: AI quota, compute, maintainer attention, review budget
propagation_channels.noise: hallucination, stale context, user expectation, hidden system state

cones_or_horizons.reachability_semantics: possible mediated workflow influence only; reachability does not prove actual downstream causality
cones_or_horizons.horizon_or_boundary: not a claim that every reachable downstream artifact is affected

feedback_dynamics.gain: higher when outputs are copied without independent review
feedback_dynamics.stability_status: can stabilize or degrade judgment depending on calibration sources

entropy_and_irreversibility.entropy_production_or_export: compute consumes energy; process changes can create irreversible publication or training effects
entropy_and_irreversibility.irreversibility_status: published errors and habit shifts may leave traces

scale_transitions.bridge_mechanism: published artifacts, customer use, policy adoption, or copied workflows

projection_rules: model output is not independent evidence
